2609.16907.title: Disrupted Companionship: A Risk Assessment Framework and Cross-Platform Quantitative Analysis of Psychosocial Responses to AI Companion Disruptions
2609.16907.paper_summary: AI companions can provide meaningful relationships, yet these relationships remain vulnerable to platform-initiated changes. We study AI companion disruptions: platform changes that alter or terminate users' ongoing companionship with an AI. We compile 30 disruption events across major platforms, develop a taxonomy of six disruption types, identify three broad reasons for disruption, and propose a risk-assessment framework comprising four dimensions: relational discontinuity, population vulnerability, communication deficit, and transition-support deficit. Using longitudinal Reddit data, we estimate community-level psychosocial responses with a hierarchical Bayesian interrupted time-series model incorporating predictive controls. Across events, disruption onset was associated with immediate increases in anxiety, stress, suicidal expression, and grief activation, with relational discontinuity and transition-support deficit being associated with more adverse immediate responses across several outcomes. Our findings provide a cross-platform characterization of AI companion disruptions, quantitative evidence of their psychosocial impacts, and a prospective framework for assessing their potential risks before implementation.
2609.16907.paper_summary_zh: AI 伴侶可以提供有意義的關係，但這些關係仍然容易受到平台主導的變化影響。<lb/>我們研究 AI 伴侶的中斷：改變或終止用戶與 AI 持續伴侶關係的平台變化。<lb/>我們編輯了 30 個主要平台的中斷事件，開發了六種類型的中斷分類法，確定了三個廣泛的中斷原因，並提出了一個包含四個維度的風險評估框架：關係中斷、人口脆弱性、溝通不足和過渡支持不足。<lb/>利用長期的 Reddit 數據，我們使用層級貝葉斯中斷時間序列模型估計社區層面的心理社會反應，並納入預測控制。<lb/>在這些事件中，中斷的開始與焦慮、壓力、自殺表達和悲傷激活的即時增加相關，關係中斷和過渡支持不足與幾個結果的更不利的即時反應相關。<lb/>我們的研究結果提供了 AI 伴侶中斷的跨平台特徵，量化了其心理社會影響的證據，並提出了一個前瞻性的框架，用於在實施前評估其潛在風險。
